sections.title: Generative AI architecture decisions ClickMasters navigates
sections.description: Every production generative AI system requires deliberate architecture choices. ClickMasters brings production experience to each decision.

blocks.heading: Model Selection
paragraphs: **GPT-4o (OpenAI / Azure OpenAI):** Best for complex reasoning, instruction following, and multi-step tasks requiring high quality. Highest cost per token.
**Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic / AWS Bedrock):** Best for long-context documents, detailed instruction following, and applications where cost-quality balance matters. AWS Bedrock provides HIPAA BAA.
**Llama 3 70B (self-hosted):** Best for data sovereignty requirements, high-volume applications where API cost is prohibitive, and applications where model fine-tuning on proprietary data is planned.
**Stable Diffusion and SDXL (self-hosted image):** Best for image generation applications where content control, volume, and cost make commercial image APIs impractical.

blocks.heading: Guardrails and Safety
paragraphs: Production generative AI requires guardrails that demos don't have — output validation, content filtering, factual consistency checking, and appropriate escalation paths when the model's confidence is low. ClickMasters builds guardrails as first-class components of every generative AI system.

blocks.heading: Evaluation Pipelines
paragraphs: Generative AI quality measurement requires human evaluation or automated metrics that correlate with human judgment — ROUGE, BERTScore, or custom task-specific evaluation. ClickMasters delivers evaluation pipelines alongside every generative AI system.

sections.title: Questions about generative AI development
sections.description: Clear technical and commercial answers before you start.

items.question: What's the minimum generative AI development budget?
items.answer: $15,000 for domain fine-tuning with existing training data. $25,000 for an LLM text generation system. $35,000 for a production RAG knowledge base.

items.question: How is generative AI different from traditional ML?
items.answer: Traditional ML predicts outputs from input features (churn probability, fraud score, demand forecast). Generative AI creates new content — text, images, or data — rather than predicting a specific outcome. The two are complementary: many production AI systems combine predictive ML (which customers are at risk?) with generative AI (what message should we send them?).

items.question: Can ClickMasters ensure generative AI outputs are accurate?
items.answer: Guaranteed factual accuracy is not possible with any generative AI system — but ClickMasters significantly reduces hallucination risk through RAG grounding, output validation, confidence scoring, and appropriate human review workflow design. We design systems with appropriate uncertainty handling, not systems that assert false confidence.

items.question: How long does generative AI development take?
items.answer: 4–20 weeks. Fine-tuning: 4–10 weeks. Full RAG with enterprise security: 14–20 weeks.

items.question: Do we own the generative AI system after delivery?
items.answer: Yes — complete IP transfer including model weights (for fine-tuned models), vector indices, pipeline code, and evaluation infrastructure.

items.question: What models do you support for generative AI?
items.answer: ClickMasters is model-agnostic: GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama 3 (self-hosted), Stable Diffusion, SDXL — and we recommend the right model for your specific use case rather than defaulting to one provider.

items.question: Do you build multi-modal AI applications?
items.answer: Yes — ClickMasters builds multi-modal AI combining text and image understanding, supporting applications like visual Q&A, document analysis with embedded images, and automated content creation workflows.

items.question: What guardrails do you build into generative AI systems?
items.answer: ClickMasters builds output validation, content filtering, factual consistency checking, confidence scoring, and appropriate escalation paths — first-class components of every generative AI system, not afterthoughts.
